about_the_game:
What lies beyond the borders?

Build a paradise. Escape the noise. Welcome to The Borderless.

In The Borderless, you begin alone on a single floating platform in the middle of the endless ocean. Burned out by the pressures of modern life, you set out to build something different, a peaceful retreat, free from stress, filled with possibility.

Start small: manage your basic needs… Happiness, Hunger, and Money as you slowly expand your floating haven. Use your earnings wisely to grow your platform, construct new buildings, and unlock entertainment that draws curious visitors from around the world.

As more guests arrive seeking joy and escape, your island transforms into a vibrant floating resort. The more fun they have, the more money you make, fueling even more growth and creativity…

Balance your own needs with those of your guests. Keep the vibe relaxed, the food flowing, and the fun non-stop. Will your floating dream remain a peaceful retreat or evolve into the ultimate destination?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Any processor with min 4 cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Escape the chaos of daily life and build your own floating paradise. In The Borderless, construct, manage, and expand a serene ocean platform into a thriving resort where visitors relax, party, and fuel your dreams with their wallets.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
